sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's bind operator silently propagates Nothing — once any step yields Nothing, every subsequent computation is skipped without error.
sketches.resonance: Grief works like Nothing in a monadic chain: once it enters, everything that follows is quietly hollowed out.
sketches.draft:
after :: Maybe a
after = return () >>= \_ ->
        Nothing  >>= \_ ->
        return () >>= \_ ->
        return () >>= \_ ->
        return ()

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no matching row exists on the right, filling unmatched columns with NULL.
sketches.resonance: You carry every place you've ever been, even the ones where no one was waiting for you.
sketches.draft:
SELECT
  places.name,
  people.name
FROM
  places
LEFT JOIN
  people
ON
  places.id = people.place_id;

sketches.mechanism: The finally block executes regardless of whether the try block succeeds or the catch block fires — it runs even during a return.
sketches.resonance: No matter what happened or what I caught, I still remember.
